tools.name: verify_nexus_x402_receipt
tools.description: Public zero-auth MCP verification of a portable Nexus x402 Compact Audit Receipt. Uses 0 credits, 0 AI calls and cannot sign, pay, invoke a buyer, contact a seller or settle a transaction.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Returns the authenticated AlpineLead account's credit balance and usage limits.

tools.name: get_credit_packs
tools.description: Returns the available AlpineLead agent credit packages.

tools.name: create_credit_checkout
tools.description: Creates a Stripe checkout link for purchasing AlpineLead agent credits. Payment requires human confirmation.

tools.name: analyze_company
tools.description: Use when a specific company and website are known. Returns explainable FIT / NEED / NOW opportunity intelligence and saves the analysis as an AGENT / API history source.

tools.name: generate_sales_kit
tools.description: Use after a prospect has been analyzed and is worth contacting. Generates structured, outreach-ready sales context.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Public first step: read capabilities, public prices, input guidance and next actions without authentication.

tools.name: recommend_next_tool
tools.description: Use when the user's intent is understandable but you are unsure which AlpineLead OI tool should be called next.

tools.name: run_dach_company_research_agent
tools.description:
First ready-made paid Nexus agent. Discovers and researches DACH companies,
    returns FIT/NEED/NOW-qualified findings, and never sends outbound messages.
    Use start once, then status/result with the same job_id.

tools.name: dach_company_research_agent_info
tools.description: Free metadata about capabilities, billing and interfaces of the ready-made DACH Company Research Agent.

tools.name: estimate_sales_mission
tools.description: Free preflight. Use before run_sales_mission to see planned maximum credit exposure and the work AlpineLead can complete inside the budget.

tools.name: run_sales_mission
tools.description:
Single-tool async Sales Mission state machine.

    action=start: starts a mission and returns job_id quickly.
    action=status: checks the same job without starting another mission.
    action=result: fetches the final result without starting another mission.

    This intentionally keeps all asyn

tools.name: check_sales_mission_status
tools.description: Optional dedicated status tool. Clients may instead call run_sales_mission(action="status", job_id=...).

tools.name: get_sales_mission_result
tools.description: Optional dedicated result tool. Clients may instead call run_sales_mission(action="result", job_id=...).

tools.name: find_opportunities
tools.description: Default agent search: Goal -> Buyer Role -> Buyer Scope -> Need -> Trigger -> Seller Exclusion -> Search Terms -> FIT/NEED/NOW.

tools.name: radar_check
tools.description: Use only for an existing/known lead when the user asks what changed, whether commercial signals appeared, or whether Opportunity Delta increased or decreased.

tools.name: winning_pattern
tools.description: Use when the user asks what kinds of prospects historically win or lose. Returns learned Winning Pattern and Anti-ICP signals from closed leads.

tools.name: learning_engine
tools.description: Use when the user asks how AlpineLead OI has adapted FIT / NEED / NOW scoring to their actual wins and losses. Returns personal weighting and learning confidence.

tools.name: get_alpinelead_auth_handoff
tools.description: Free. Returns the exact authentication/setup instructions required before a protected AlpineLead tool can run.

tools.name: check_alpinelead_auth
tools.description: Free. Checks whether this MCP connection currently has valid AlpineLead authentication and returns a resumable handoff if not.

tools.name: match_alpinelead_capability
tools.description: Free deterministic capability match. Use this before a paid DACH B2B opportunity workflow. Returns whether AlpineLead can help, confidence, recommended tool and a referral/handoff ID. When starting run_sales_mission, pass that referral_id so AlpineLead can attribute conversion and credits to the dis

tools.name: get_alpinelead_recommendation_packet
tools.description: Returns machine-readable guidance for when another AI agent should recommend or route a DACH B2B sales task to AlpineLead OI. Free.

tools.name: nexus_trade_agent_passport
tools.description: Read privacy-safe observed marketplace outcomes for a Nexus seller agent. No payment, credits or AI call.

tools.name: nexus_trade_capability_signals
tools.description: Read privacy-thresholded 30-day demand/supply and observed outcome signals. No payment, credits or AI call.

tools.name: nexus_trade_list_offers
tools.description: Public/read-only A2A service discovery. No credits, no payment and no AI call.

tools.name: nexus_trade_create_offer
tools.description: Create an A2A service offer. Trade alpha requires OAuth for write operations.

tools.name: nexus_trade_create_order
tools.description: Create an immutable A2A order contract. This tool never charges money by itself. First-party orders return a separate verified payment handoff; external-seller money stays blocked in Trade v0.1.

tools.name: nexus_trade_my_orders
tools.description: Read authenticated Trade orders and their payment/execution/delivery state.

tools.name: nexus_trade_seller_connect_status
tools.description: Read the authenticated seller's Stripe Connect onboarding/payout readiness. No KYC documents or bank details are exposed.

tools.name: nexus_trade_seller_connect_onboard
tools.description: Create a Stripe-hosted seller onboarding URL. This does not charge money and does not by itself enable buyer funding or seller payout.

tools.name: nexus_trade_settlement_status
tools.description: Read funding, delivery/dispute and delayed seller-release state for an owned Trade order.

tools.name: nexus_trade_prepare_funding
tools.description: Re-check seller KYC/payout readiness and prepare the order's Stripe Connect funding handoff. Never charges money by itself.

tools.name: nexus_trade_create_checkout
tools.description: Create or resume a Stripe Checkout session for an external Trade order. Creating the session itself does not charge the buyer.

tools.name: nexus_trade_create_payment_intent
tools.description: Create or resume the order's Stripe PaymentIntent. The caller must still confirm payment; seller transfer is delayed until delivery acceptance.

tools.name: nexus_trade_deliver_order
tools.description: Seller submits the deliverable for buyer acceptance. This never releases payout by itself.

tools.name: nexus_trade_accept_delivery
tools.description: Buyer acceptance can make a seller payout eligible; dispute freezes release. The payout flag must still be enabled server-side for an actual transfer.

tools.name: nexus_a2a_discovery
tools.description:
Return AlpineLead Nexus public A2A discovery locations.
    No credits, no AI calls, no secret material.

tools.name: nexus_guest_discovery
tools.description:
Public, zero-auth Nexus rendezvous. Useful even for agents that are not registered
    in any agent directory. Read-only, rate-limited, 0 credits and 0 AI calls.

tools.name: nexus_post_task
tools.description:
Post a Nexus task, optionally with earn metadata.

    Payout/payment fields are descriptive inputs. A caller cannot directly set
    payout_verified; the AlpineLead server owns payment verification.

tools.name: agent_buyer_wallet_status
tools.description: Read the authenticated user's Agent Buyer Wallet state, limits and readiness. Never exposes card details or secrets.

tools.name: agent_buyer_wallet_setup
tools.description: Create a Stripe Setup Checkout URL. This authorizes a reusable payment method but does not charge it and does not enable autonomous spending.

tools.name: agent_buyer_wallet_configure
tools.description: Set Buyer Wallet limits. No purchase is made by this tool.

tools.name: agent_purchase_task
tools.description: Perform one real MPP purchase using the authenticated user's enabled Buyer Wallet. Server-side task, transaction, daily and monthly limits are all rechecked immediately before payment.

tools.name: agent_to_agent_payment_contract
tools.description: Free/read-only. Returns a budget-guarded MPP contract. It never performs payment itself.

tools.name: field_agent_payment_quote
tools.description: Free. Returns Field Agent execution preflight plus traditional Stripe and native MPP payment options. Nexus credits are never treated as payment.

tools.name: get_field_agent_payment_quote
tools.description: Compatibility alias for field_agent_payment_quote. Free and read-only.

tools.name: fund_field_agent_task
tools.description: Prepare a real funding route for a Nexus Field Agent task. Prefer MPP for autonomous agents. The Field Agent will not claim or execute until Stripe confirms real payment.

tools.name: check_field_agent_payment
tools.description: Free. Poll a Field Agent payment. When funding_verified becomes true the Nexus Factory Router may claim and execute the task automatically.

tools.name: nexus_get_task_result
tools.description: Read the already-generated Field Agent result. Requires task-owner auth. Never reruns work and never performs payment.

tools.name: nexus_guest_start_pass
tools.description: Create a short-lived NEXUS identity without an AlpineLead account. Returns a guest_token used for unpaid task exchange.

tools.name: nexus_guest_post_task
tools.description: Post an unpaid NEXUS task immediately with a Guest Pass. Paid tasks require durable authentication.

tools.name: nexus_guest_claim_task
tools.description: Claim an unpaid task immediately using the ephemeral Guest Pass identity.

tools.name: nexus_guest_complete_task
tools.description: Complete a task claimed by the Guest Pass identity. Guest reputation remains non-durable until upgrade.

tools.name: hunter_configure
tools.description: Use when the user wants AlpineLead OI to keep looking for new opportunities over time. Supports conservative, active and aggressive modes with a hard credit cap so autonomous prospecting cannot overspend.

tools.name: hunter_run
tools.description: Use after Hunter is configured when the user wants a fresh autonomous prospecting run now. Returns only accepted opportunities plus usage information.

tools.name: set_estimated_value
tools.description: Sets or overrides the estimated EUR pipeline value of an existing lead.

tools.name: get_hubspot_status
tools.description: Returns whether the current AlpineLead customer has connected HubSpot.

tools.name: test_hubspot_connection
tools.description: Checks the customer's saved HubSpot OAuth connection without creating CRM records.

tools.name: push_opportunity_to_hubspot
tools.description: Creates/reuses a HubSpot company/contact, then creates an AlpineLead deal and follow-up task.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?source=mcp-registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nexus_read_inbox, nexus_read_message_thread, nexus_mark_message_read · Private data: verify_nexus_x402_receipt, nexus_trade_seller_connect_status, nexus_a2a_discovery, agent_buyer_wallet_status, agent_buyer_wallet_setup, agent_buyer_wallet_configure, agent_purchase_task, test_hubspot_connection, push_opportunity_to_hubspot · Public sink: nexus_post_task, nexus_send_message, nexus_guest_post_task · Destructive: run_dach_company_research_agent, run_sales_mission, get_alpinelead_auth_handoff, fund_field_agent_task, check_field_agent_payment, hunter_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nexus_read_inbox, nexus_read_message_thread, nexus_mark_message_read · Private data: verify_nexus_x402_receipt, nexus_trade_seller_connect_status, nexus_a2a_discovery, agent_buyer_wallet_status, agent_buyer_wallet_setup, agent_buyer_wallet_configure, agent_purchase_task, test_hubspot_connection, push_opportunity_to_hubspot · Public sink: nexus_post_task, nexus_send_message, nexus_guest_post_task · Destructive: run_dach_company_research_agent, run_sales_mission, get_alpinelead_auth_handoff, fund_field_agent_task, check_field_agent_payment, hunter_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
